assumptions.name: Households simulated
assumptions.why: Runtime; densities and meetings scale with it

assumptions.name: Phones
assumptions.why: Smartphone ownership among older adults is lower than average

assumptions.name: Radio range
assumptions.why: Bluetooth LE or Wi-Fi Direct outdoors between cars and houses

assumptions.name: Mobile data in the zone
assumptions.value: 8% of phones, online 30% of the time
assumptions.why: Towers lose power and backhaul in a wildfire

assumptions.name: Gateways
assumptions.value: 25% of phones agree to upload for others

assumptions.name: Everyone who reaches safety is online
assumptions.why: Shelter Wi-Fi or working networks outside the zone

assumptions.name: Street blockages
assumptions.value: logistic in fire proximity, road class and time, spatially clustered
assumptions.why: lib/flow/blockage.ts; no published per-street data exists

assumptions.name: Departures
assumptions.why: UC Berkeley survey of California wildfire evacuees

privacy.mechanism: Gaussian noise on each phone's clipped update (local differential privacy)
